description:
She was kicked out of her homestay but was successful in finding a new home thanks to a middle-aged man she met by chance at a Korean church, but this man's son was supposed to be a senior at the same school as her?! He is a former student council president who introduces his Korean name as “Yeonwoo”. Besides, this guy is super popular at school?! Our MC, who wanted to live a quiet life, begins her homestay life!

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Peanutoon](https://www.peanutoon.com/ko/comic/detail/6686), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9868972)
